title: Robust Non-Clairvoyant Scheduling with Classification Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.01343v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the classical single-machine scheduling problem of minimizing the sum of completion times of jobs in a non-clairvoyant setting, where the processing time of each job remains unknown until its completion. This is a hard problem for which no constant competitive algorithm is possible. Inspired by robust optimization and learning-augmented algorithms, we introduce a novel robustness framework that leverages structural information provided by a classification model to overcome this limitation. Specifically, we assume that jobs are partitioned into classes and we have access to the confusion matrix of the classifier, whose entry $(k,\ell)$ indicates the number of jobs predicted to belong to class~$k$ but that actually belong to class~$\ell$. In this manner, we are able to characterize uncertainty as a set of permutations within each predicted class, rather than as a collection of discrete numerical scenarios, avoiding the computation

translated_title: 基于分类模型的鲁棒非预知调度
translated_abstract: 我们研究了经典的单机调度问题，即在非预知（non-clairvoyant）设置下最小化作业完成时间之和，其中每个作业的处理时间在完成之前是未知的。这是一个困难问题，不存在常数竞争比的算法。受鲁棒优化和学习增强算法的启发，我们引入了一种新颖的鲁棒性框架，该框架利用分类模型提供的结构信息来克服这一限制。具体而言，我们假设作业被划分为若干类别，并且我们可以获取分类器的混淆矩阵，其条目 (k,ℓ) 表示被预测属于类别 k 但实际属于类别 ℓ 的作业数量。通过这种方式，我们能够将不确定性刻画为每个预测类别内的一组排列，而不是离散数值场景的集合，从而避免了计算……
tldr: 提出了一种利用分类模型混淆矩阵作为结构信息的新型鲁棒性框架，将不确定性刻画为预测类别内的作业排列，从而应对不存在常数竞争比算法的非预知单机调度难题。
en_tdlr: A novel robustness framework is introduced that leverages the confusion matrix of a classification model to characterize uncertainty as permutations within predicted classes, tackling the hard non-clairvoyant single-machine scheduling problem of minimizing total completion time for which no constant competitive algorithm exists.
